Generation II is [[hub:Foreigners]] or [[hub:Creature]]. At the end of this Generation the Fates use one of two tests, 50/50:
  • The execution at the end of the Middle Years: the Butcher hanged → [[hub:Foreigners]], the Blacksmith → [[hub:Creature]].
  • The mob: nobody claimed a Family Plot → [[hub:Foreigners]], anyone did → [[hub:Creature]].
Now: {{0=|nobody has been executed yet|the Blacksmith was executed|the Butcher was executed}} - {{1=?|a Family Plot was claimed|no Family Plot claimed yet}}.
Now: your village name decides it: {{0=?|[[hub:Foreigners]]|[[hub:Creature]]}}, whatever the Fates test.
If the Fates test the mob at the end of this Generation (50/50 with the execution), any claimed Family Plot leads to [[hub:Creature]]. Nobody claiming one leads to [[hub:Foreigners]].

If the Fates test the execution at the end of this Generation (50/50 with the mob): the Butcher → [[hub:Foreigners]], the Blacksmith → [[hub:Creature]]. In [[hub:Tension]] a hanged Butcher also counts against you.

Generation III is [[hub:Isolation]] or [[hub:Tension]]. At the end of this Generation the Fates use one of two tests, 50/50:
  • The bricks all players collected: enough → the Memorial Wall → [[hub:Isolation]], too few → [[hub:Tension]]. The number needed is drawn: {{0=|2 to 5|4 to 8|6 to 9}}.
  • The witch at the Accusations (end of the Middle Years): unmasked → [[hub:Tension]], not unmasked → [[hub:Isolation]].
Now: {{0=|the witch is accused at the end of the Middle Years|the witch was unmasked|the wrong person was accused}}.
Bricks bought here count for one of the two tests at the end of this Generation: enough bricks → [[hub:Isolation]]. If Generation III is [[hub:Tension]], choosing Strength counts against you there.

If the Fates test the witch at the end of this Generation (50/50 with the bricks): unmasking the witch → [[hub:Tension]], accusing the wrong person → [[hub:Isolation]]. In [[hub:Tension]] a wrong accusation counts against you.
Enough bricks → [[hub:Isolation]]. Too few → [[hub:Tension]].

Generation III is [[hub:Liberal]] or [[hub:Privatized]]. At the end of this Generation the Fates use one of two tests, 50/50:
  • The Creature: you created the Creature your grandfather asks for → [[hub:Liberal]], otherwise [[hub:Privatized]].
  • The money: the Asylum received at least as much as the Count → [[hub:Liberal]], the Count more → [[hub:Privatized]].
Money given in secret is not tallied here.
If the Fates test the money at the end of this Generation (50/50 with the Creature): the Asylum receiving at least as much as the Count → [[hub:Liberal]], the Count more → [[hub:Privatized]].
If the Fates test the Creature (50/50 with the money): created → [[hub:Liberal]], not created → [[hub:Privatized]].

Yes → [[end:1]]. No → [[end:2]].
